name: org-chart-maker
description: Turn a staff list into a clean organisation chart. Each person just needs a name, a title, a department and who they report to; the chart is laid out automatically, coloured by department or level, with large teams stacked neatly. Collapse a branch to show “+N”, limit how many levels appear, and fix reporting lines by editing the manager column — missing managers, loops and duplicate names are flagged. Export SVG, a high-resolution PNG and a one-page PDF. Runs locally; no account or API keys.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 把一份员工名单变成清晰的组织架构图。每人只需要姓名、职位、部门和直属上级，自动排版，按部门或层级配色，人数多的小组会整齐竖排。可以折叠某个分支显示“+N”、限制显示的层数，在“上级”列里改汇报关系——找不到的上级、循环汇报和重名都会标出来。导出 SVG、高清 PNG 和一页 PDF。在本地运行，不用登录，无需 API 密钥。
